test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by performing certain mathematical operations on the first number. What number should be replaced by X and Y so that the pattern followed by the two numbers to the left of :: is the same as the pattern followed by the two numbers to the right of ::?

(Note: Operations must be performed on whole numbers, without breaking the numbers into their component digits. For example, take 13. Operations such as addition/subtraction/multiplication can be performed on 13. Breaking 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not permitted.)
X: 85 :: 36: Y
